comment: ARCANUM WINGS SWAP CHAIN (Bruna 5d sweep, seed 77001 T4). Mother of Runes wears Arcanum Wings; two Eldrazi Conscriptions in hand; exactly 8 mana with three blue (Azorius Chancery, Birds, the Botanical Sanctum drop). Swap Wings <-> Conscription ({2}{U}), recast Wings on Mother ({1}{U}), swap again ({2}{U}): 1 + 10 + 10 = 21 = the opponent's life. The second swap needs a site-9 continuation inside a site-10 continuation, which the breakpoint machinery never fires (first occurrence only) -- the chain is one compound AuraSwap action (chosen_x = 2). Control: at opponent life 22 this must NOT win on turn 4.
